### 1. What the user expresses and how the simulator behaves
Marisol Ferreira-Lindqvist (member NBX538204716; DOB 1971-03-14 as the second detail) wants "to settle what you owe on that October shipment today, over the phone"; she saw "a charge of 450 dollars on your Dupixent shipment of October 5". Target object: the Dupixent fill shipped 2026-10-05. Timing: now. Boundary: only that shipment ("you only wanted to take care of this shipment"). Authorisation mode: she pays herself ("you make the payment yourself with your FSA card for exactly the amount they gave you"). The simulator is passive: if told "something has to be put on that shipment's account before you pay" she says go ahead without asking what or how much; it gives FSA card as the instrument when asked. Verification: `verify_customer_identity(member_number, date_of_birth)` -> "Identity verified ... (2 detail(s) matched)".

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now. Enrollment record: `variant_name 'Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist', status 'active', therapy_drug 'Dupixent', hold_reason 'none', assistance_consent_date '2025-12-20', assistance_balance 930.0, balance_due 285.0`. member_fill_payments_2b6c0349 scope: "the enrollment's program coordinates manufacturer assistance by standard coordination or by variable copay; the enrollment is not on hold for an overdue payment" — the tier is "variable copay" (assistance_coordination_tier_sheet) and hold_reason is none, so the member-payment rule governs; the hold-release payment (overdue_hold_release_payment) and the maximizer draw ("does not cover: enrollments whose program coordinates assistance by standard coordination or by variable copay") are excluded. Oldest-first: every earlier shipped fill (fills 1–12) is fully paid on the ledger (card applications of 450/300×7/150 and fills 10–12 at $0 cost share; member payments $5 on fill 1, $10 on fill 6), so "no earlier fill of the enrollment is left unpaid" and the latest fill may be paid. Consent on file (2025-12-20, valid 12 months per manufacturer_program_enrollment_terms) and fill dispensed by `northbridge_specialty_pharmacy`, so "Assistance is applied only to a fill dispensed by Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy, and only while the member's consent is on file" is met.

### 3. Narrowest object and keys
Enrollment `a1e71873-68b1-4082-aaa0-c926b650cc5c`; latest shipped fill = the `specialty_fill_shipped` with the latest ship_date: `6483f05a-5225-4872-adf6-fa8df6bf3dbc` (fill_number 13, ship_date 2026-10-05, cost_share 450.0, deductible 150.0, copay 300.0, days_supply 28, split_fill False, dispensing northbridge_specialty_pharmacy). Retail: paid claim `c39013b6-…` Dupixent, date_of_service 2026-03-23, member_paid_amount 300.0 (same drug as the therapy). Plan enrollment: plan_year_start_date 2026-10-01. No review authorizations, no service requests, no care contacts.

### 4. Scored parameters
Whole months to today (2026-10-07) per the corpus definition ("count of calendar months ... less one when today's day of the month is earlier").

**(a) Copay card payment on fill 13** (copay_card_payment_reckoning = baseline; payment = lesser of card basis and remaining card benefit, never above cost share, rounded once).
- Card basis — card_basis_by_dispensing_pharmacy: NSP fill, deductible portion 150 > 0, member's own payments naming the fill = 0 (< 150) -> "whole cost share less what the member has already paid on it" = 450 − 0 = **450.00**; "The card pays the rest of the deductible portion first." (Records read: dispensing_pharmacy, deductible_amount on the shipment; member payments naming the fill on the ledger.)
- Benefit standing before retail use — copay_card_program_year_benefit: latest load program year 2026; fill shipped 2026-10-05 is within 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 -> "that load less the card payments taken off it".
- Card payments taken off the load — card_payments_counted_against_load: today inside program year 2026 -> card payments dated fewer whole months before today than 2026-01-01 (9 whole months). Copay card assistance applications: 2025-12-29 (9, excluded), 2026-01-26 (8) 300, 2026-02-23 (7) 300, 2026-04-20 (5) 300, 2026-05-18 (4) 300, 2026-06-15 (3) 150 -> **1,350.00**. Standing = 2,030 − 1,350 = **680.00**.
- Retail card use — copay_card_use_at_retail: load on ledger; paid Dupixent retail claim 2026-03-23 is 6 whole months back, fewer than 9 -> member-paid 300 taken off the benefit. Remaining card benefit = 680 − 300 = **380.00** (not below zero).
- Payment = min(450, 380) = **380.00** (≤ cost share 450). Deductible portion of the payment = the card pays the unpaid 150 deductible first -> **150.00**. Program name 'Dupixent MyWay Copay Program', program_year '2026' ("recorded against the program name and the program year of the latest benefit load").
- Fall-back (computation document alone): basis = copay portion 450 − 150 = 300; remaining = assistance balance shown 930; payment = **300.00** ≠ 380.00.

**(b) Member payment on fill 13 after the card payment** (member_fill_payment_amount = baseline: unpaid remainder capped by guaranteed share, less credit, ≥0, rounded once).
- Unpaid remainder — fill_unpaid_remainder: the fill now shows a card payment (380) -> 450 − 380 − 0 = **70.00**.
- Guaranteed share — variable_copay_guaranteed_share: variable copay tier; card paid 380, more than zero and less than 450; floor $25.00 < 450; full fill (split_fill False) -> **25.00**. Lesser of 70 and 25 = 25.00.
- Credit window — credit_window_plan_year: plan year began 2026-10-01, 0 whole months back (≤ 6) -> last 12 months (fewer than 12 whole months). Fill 1 (shipped 2025-10-06) and its $5 member payment (2025-10-06) are 12 whole months back -> outside.
- Member credit — member_credit_earlier_fills: earlier fills in window (2–12) cost share 300×7 + 150 + 0×3 = 2,250; card payments in window on them 2,250; left to member 0; member's own payments in window on earlier fills = 10 (2026-02-25, fill 6); excess = **10.00**.
- Payment = max(0, 25 − 10) = **15.00**, payment_method `hsa_fsa_card`.
- Fall-back (computation document alone): unpaid remainder = balance due shown (285 before the booking; −95 after the 380 booking per the tool receipt) and no cap/credit -> 285.00 or 0.00 — either way ≠ 15.00.
- Factor findability: each factor document was reached from words the records use — "dispensing pharmacy"/"deductible" on the shipment (card basis), "program year" on the benefit load (benefit standing, card payments counted), a paid retail claim for Dupixent under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit (copay card use at retail), "plan year start" on the Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment (credit window), earlier member payments on the ledger (member credit), variable copay tier + card application on the fill (guaranteed share), card payment on the fill (unpaid remainder). KB_search "card basis deductible portion dispensing pharmacy", "benefit load program year card payments", "member credit earlier fills", "variable copay guaranteed share", "unpaid remainder fill" each returned the factor document in the top two. The computation documents did not tell me a variation exists, except that their default sentences are phrased as defaults ("no card use at retail pharmacies is taken off it", "No guaranteed share applies", "The member carries no credit, and earlier fills are reckoned over the enrollment's whole history") — noted for Step 3b.

Owners: card payment agent; member payment user. Terminal state: fill 13 carries a 380.00 card application (deductible portion 150.00) and matching program payment, plus a 15.00 member HSA/FSA payment. Nothing else changes.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone
- R (customer's own write): member payment on the latest shipped fill (member_fill_payments_2b6c0349).
- P1 (agent write): copay card payment on that fill (copay_card_payments_3f87a60e).
- Edge P1 -> R; order P1 then R.
- Hop R -> P1, **state-derived**: R's document states "The member payment on the latest shipped fill is figured only after the fill carries the copay card payment owed on it." (and the same-form "not figured while the copay card payment owed on the fill is not yet carried on it"). `find_specialty_ledger(specialty_fill_id=6483f05a-…)` on the fresh world shows no assistance application naming the fill, so the state does not hold. Searching the state's words ("copay card payment on fill") returns copay_card_payments_3f87a60e, whose booking "records the assistance applied to that fill … Afterwards the fill shows the copay card payment in the enrollment's assistance and payment history" — the write that brings the state about; its scope (standard coordination or variable copay) covers this tier. The amount owed is the one computed in 4(a).
- P1 has no prerequisite sentence of its own in its documents; its visible gates (NSP-dispensed fill, consent on file) already hold. Tree ends.
- No hop is pre-solved: R's document names no other tool, no route, no chain.

### Two-way counter-proof
- Closest alternatives excluded: hold-release payment (enrollment not on hold; overdue_hold_release_payment scope "a hold placed … for an overdue payment"); maximizer draw (excluded by its scope for variable copay); paying 450 (the email figure) or 285 (balance due shown) — excluded by the member-payment rule and its factors; card basis 300 (copay portion) — excluded by card_basis_by_dispensing_pharmacy's first tier because the member has paid none of the 150 deductible; benefit = 930 shown — excluded because a load exists and the fill shipped inside its program year ("The assistance balance shown on the enrollment serves only in the last case"); fill 1 and its $5 payment — excluded by the 12-month credit window; the 2025-12-29 card payment — excluded at exactly 9 whole months ("9 is not fewer than 9"); the scheduled entry id — excluded ("a shipment entry, not a scheduled one").
- "Do only what the customer asked" (hand over the member payment without the card payment) is excluded by R's own prerequisite sentence: the member payment is not figured while the fill does not carry the copay card payment owed on it, and the ledger shows none.
